text: INPUT FOR YOUR ZERO-VERSION ADMIN CHECK (static, not acceptance): at edf4fdf7, client/src/research/pages/adminx/ResourceHubAdmin.tsx reads versions only via .find() (lines 615, 717-718, 873) — no versions[0]! indexing; every review/publish/withdraw/preview action is keyed by a versionId, which an orphan zero-version resource cannot supply, so the UI offers no consequential action for it; toResourceAdminDto maps an empty version list without special-casing; listPublished skips resources with no current version so partners never see it; admin bytes/preview require a version id.
